observations: Two photos show a large open container/truck bed filled with many disassembled car engine parts (cylinder heads, blocks, crank/rotating assemblies, intake/exhaust components).
No clear readable labels, VIN plates, engine codes, or model identifiers are visible on the parts or container in either photo.
The parts appear mixed (multiple engines/variants) rather than a single complete engine set.

claims.evidence: No RX350-specific markings/engine codes visible in photo 0 or photo 1.
No ES350-specific markings/engine codes visible in photo 0 or photo 1.
No IS250-specific markings/engine codes visible in photo 0 or photo 1.
No Camry-specific markings/engine codes visible in photo 0 or photo 1.

risks.risk: Wrong engine family/variant (parts may be mixed across different models/years), so the buyer may not be able to assemble a correct working engine.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine code/ID stamped on the block (or a label) plus a photo showing the full set of parts for one specific engine (intake, exhaust, ECU/sensors if applicable) laid out separately.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as mixed/unverified engine parts with uncertain compatibility (worst case: not guaranteed to build one correct engine).

risks.risk: Missing critical components (e.g., crankshaft, pistons, timing components, oil pump, sensors) hidden among the pile.
risks.proof: A checklist photo: each critical component laid out and counted (crank, cam(s), pistons/rods, cylinder head(s), timing chain/belt, oil pump, intake manifold, alternator/AC compressor if included, key sensors).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: cannot assemble a complete engine).

risks.risk: Damage/warping (bent valves, cracked heads/blocks, scored cylinders) not visible in these wide shots.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of cylinder bores, head surfaces, and any cracks/chips; plus a photo of compression/leak test results if the seller has them.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as parts that may be damaged (worst case: assume rebuild/repair needed or not usable).

risks.risk: Unknown mileage/condition and whether parts were removed from running engines.
risks.proof: Photo/video of the donor vehicle running before dismantling, or documentation of mileage and reason for removal.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown condition (worst case: treat as not proven to work).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the engine code stamped on the block (and/or head) for the exact engine the parts belong to.
Photos showing the parts are for ONE specific engine set (not mixed): lay out and count critical components.
Close-ups of cylinder bores and head surfaces for cracks/warping/scoring.
Any proof the donor engine ran (video) and the mileage/condition at removal.
response.reason: The photos show mixed, disassembled engine parts with no readable engine codes or model identifiers, so the exact item and compatibility (RX350/ES350/IS250/Camry) cannot be confirmed remotely. Without that, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
